summary: Master accrual accounting with our training course. Enhance your skills and boost your career with expert-led lessons and practical insights.
lede: Accrual accounting records income when earned and expenses when incurred, giving finance professionals a view beyond cash movements. The course is for people who prepare, review or use budgets and financial statements and need to report accurately on financial activity. Participants practise recognizing revenue and expenses, managing receivables and payables, recording prepayments and accruals, reconciling accounts, and interpreting financial statements.
audienceIntro: This course is for professionals who handle or rely on financial statements, reporting, compliance, or budgets.
modules: Accrual Accounting Fundamentals for Real-World Reporting
Chart of Accounts, Ledgers, and Transaction Structure
Expense Recognition and the Matching Principle
Receivables Management and Credit Control Basics
Fixed Assets and Depreciation Without Confusion
Month-End Close: Accrual Entries, Adjustments, and Quality Checks
Accrual Accounting for Donor and Public Sector Reporting
Communicating Accrual-Based Results to Non-Finance Stakeholders
prerequisites: Basic understanding of financial statements and accounting principles is recommended. Participants should be familiar with general accounting software.
